overloads.semanticRole: The Pasteboard data size command checks whether there is any data of the type you passed in dataType present in the pasteboard.

constraints: Returns -102 if the pasteboard is empty or contains no data of the specified type; otherwise returns the size (in bytes) of that data.
dataType accepts a 4D signature, a UTI type (macOS), a format name/number (Windows), or a legacy 4-character type.
